Name: Elkanah, Son of Ziklag Band
Summary: One of those who came to David at Ziklag, of the Korhites.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:6: One of those who came to David at Ziklag, of the Korhites.
LifeLesson: The mention of Elkanah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
